definitions.explanation: Describes a sound that is clear, loud, and carries far. Often implies a bold or confident quality to the sound.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}した→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧。

⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧トロフィー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲|かか}げ→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}えた→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: The players held the championship trophy up high and responded to the cheers of the crowd.

notes:
A na-adjective, but used almost exclusively in the adverbial form {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. The na-adjective form ({高|たか}らかな) is rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (laugh out loud)
- {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}する→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧ (declare triumphantly)
- {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧ (sing out boldly)
- {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧ (hold up high, display proudly)

USAGE:
Conveys confidence, boldness, or triumph. The ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ form functions as an adverb modifying the following verb. Distinguished from simply ⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high/loud) by its literary and dramatic tone — {高|たか}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ implies a deliberate, proud quality, not just volume.
